attchmntText: Regaal Resources Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Regaal Resources Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 3,165.62 Million. Profit before tax for the quarter was Rs. 310.81 Million. Profit for the period was Rs. 231.84 Million. Earnings per share was Rs. 2.25. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue was Rs. 5,187.11 Million. Profit before tax was Rs. 489.44 Million. Profit for the period was Rs. 365.12 Million. Earnings per share was Rs. 3.55. The company issued 2,70,400 equity shares under its employee stock option plan. An exceptional item of Rs. 6.43 Million was recorded due to SGST reimbursement issues. Statutory auditors M/s Singhi & Co issued a limited review report.

attchmntText: Regaal Resources Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Earnings Conference Call for the Q2 & H1 FY27
voiceSummary: Regaal Resources Limited has scheduled its earnings conference call for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2027. The call will take place on Monday, November 16, 2026, at 11:30 AM. The management team, including Chairman and Managing Director Anil Kishorepuria, Whole time Director Karan Kishorepuria, and Chief Financial Officer Saikat Chatterjee, will participate. The event is open to analysts and institutional investors. Registration details and dial-in numbers are available on the company website at https://regaalresources.com/schedule-of-analyst-or-investors-meet/ and through Arihant Capital Markets Ltd. Participants are requested to join five to ten minutes prior to the scheduled time.
